name: punk-avatar
tagline_zh: 宠物、人像、物件都能变酷炫头像，还能把风格存成模板反复用。别家只出图，这里连头像纪念卡都给你备好。
tagline_en: Turn pets, people, or objects into punk avatars, save styles as reusable prompts. Others just draw; we also craft.
desc_en: Generate avatar images and reusable avatar image prompts from the shared Punk style library for people, pets, objects, profile pictures, pet portraits, and avatar-derived keepsake cards. Use this skill to identify the subject from image or text, choose one avatar-capable style, compile the selected style atom into the avatar blueprint, save the final prompt, and generate the image when an image-ge
why_zh: 强在把风格拆成原子组件，每次生成都复用同一套蓝图，头像风格稳定不跑偏，还能顺手做纪念卡。
why_en: It decomposes styles into atomic components, reusing the same blueprint for consistent avatars and bonus keepsake cards.
unshelve_reason: 问二 · 同类聚簇审查（簇 B：文章封面 / 配图 / 社交卡）。与 punk-cover 是同一套编译器逐字换词的两份：同一句核心规则、同一组三输入、同一个确认闸门、同一个保存与生图流程，差别只在输出光圈（1:1 vs 平台比例）和从共享 styles/ 库里放行哪几个风格。说不清「为什么是它不是 punk-cover」在机制层的独占——肖像保真只是 blueprint 里的一个字段，不是一套机制。同一作者已占三位，这一位应让给真正独占的 punk-ip-illustrations 和 punk-cover。 正文原话：punk-cover 正文：「`punk-cover` is a cover-generation workflow, not a style owner. Select exactly one reusable style from the repository-level `styles/` library, then compile that style atom into the cover shape. The final image prompt is not a loose concatenation of "cover instructions + style instructions". It must be one integrated, cover-specific prompt that applies the selected style to the cover format.」／ punk-avatar 正文：「`punk-avatar` is an avatar-shape workflow, not a style owner. Select exactly one reusable style from the repository-level `styles/` library, then compile that style atom into the avatar shape. The final image prompt is not a loose concatenation of "avatar instructions + style instructions". It must be one integrated, avatar-specific prompt that applies the selected style to a profile image...」
